rationale: Codex's pin is the only one that limits pane scrollbars and client mouse to the agents the issue names, matches existing clients exactly with has-session -t =<client>, and clears the scrollback wait on receipt, early returns and status ineligibility, leaving only a cosmetic observedAt reset, whereas claude's pin widens scope and misses receipt clearing and cursor's widens scope, uses non-exact session matching and adds unneeded exports.
